content: I've taken your info. Now feel free to ask me anything.
I'm here to listen and help. How are you feeling today?
I'm not sure I have much to share, but I can suggest some things to help you relax. Have you tried deep breathing exercises or meditation?

Rest and keep hydrated, and avoid activities that worsen the pain. Note when the pain started, its severity and any triggers to share with the clinician. Seek care promptly if pain is severe, worsening or accompanied by fever, swelling or breathing difficulty. General over-the-counter options that in many places do not require a prescription include paracetamol (acetaminophen) and ibuprofen. Follow the label and ask a pharmacist or doctor. This is general information only -- please check the package label and ask a pharmacist or doctor before use. Suitability depends on allergies, other medicines and health conditions.
